This portfolio collects a series of real projects I have developed at work, with a focus on financial data, treasury workflows, and analytics. The projects are designed to be reproducible and demonstrate my skills in data engineering, analysis, and visualization.

::: {.project-card}
### FX Prime Brokerage Collateral

A workflow improvement approach for FX prime brokerage collateral management, based on a financial-services use case. The portfolio version uses synthetic data to reproduce the analytical workflow while preserving the structure of the underlying business problem, including new Power BI dashboards for collateral reporting and monitoring.

::: {.project-links}
[Presentation (PDF)](fx-prime-brokerage-collateral/presentation/fx-primer-broker-collateral.pdf){target="_blank"} · [PowerPoint](fx-prime-brokerage-collateral/presentation/fx-primer-broker-collateral.pptx) · [Open the report](fx-prime-brokerage-collateral/report.qmd)
:::
